limitations: SERP supplements have name/address/coordinates/masterId, but no full hotel/category snapshot. Their source pointer is the city cached card, not a made-up individual hotel URL.
D28 supplement is exhaustive over cached valid geographically matching records, not an operating-hotels census. Exact ~100 target cannot override no-new-OTA-request restriction.
Subzone tags use disclosed address/coordinate rules and are approximate geographic strata, not surveyed administrative boundaries.
No cached Dagomys entity satisfies hotel identity/address/coordinates checks; absence in cache is not absence of hotels.
